summary_1line: Kripa advises cautious policy about the Pandavas while Susarman and Karna persuade Duryodhana to raid King Virata’s cattle, launching a coordinated Trigarta–Kaurava attack.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a royal council, Susarman speaks urgently to Duryodhana while Karna watches approvingly and the Kaurava elders sit in tense deliberation.
The Trigarta army marches at dawn with chariots, infantry, and banners, advancing toward Matsya to seize the royal cattle.
Kaurava warriors drive away thousands of lowing cattle across dusty plains as soldiers guard the herd in battle formation.
